programs.description: Gauri, an average village girl, falls in love with a wealthy city man, Samir. Later, when Samir goes abroad to study law, the unusual couple must survive turmoil.
The host plays devotional songs that praise the Almighty and imbues oneself with peace and tranquility and explores various places of worship.
A young, vivacious and educated woman named Gauri does her bit to support her ageing father in his endeavours to write a book and constantly assists those who need her help in reading and writing.
Gopal Bhar is appointed as a jester in Raja Krishnachandra's court in medieval Bengal. His wit and humour are well-known in the region and his exploits always have a significant social message.
Adu, a poor Hindu girl, lives in a small village in India and marries Suleman, a Muslim garment supplier. Suleman leaves for Iraq to earn a living, but the war changes everything.
Bandana, a young designer, is furious when a defect causes her to share a telephone line with Goonjan, a singer. Though she hates him initially, she soon grows fond of him.
Samita rescues Parul, a village girl, from the clutches of human trafficking with the help of Surajit, a journalist. She tries to find a shelter for Parul while struggling with her own problems.
A prostitute goes to extreme lengths to make ends meet and support her daughter's future. However, her life turns upside down after several unidentified people push her daughter into the flesh trade.
